{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABY1jszQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhCbH90", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 102, "title": "Tune Gene Light PMX demo lights to 0x888888 and investigate washed-out rendering", "body": "## Problem

The **PMX — Gene (Light)** Example appears much brighter / more washed out than the PMD Miku Examples even after #96/#97 changed the direct-light material equations and #98/#100 adjusted demo lighting. The maintainer reports that setting **both** Gene scene lights to gray **RGB `0x888888`** looks appreciably better. The reason for the discrepancy has not yet been established.

Currently, [`examples/scene.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/scene.ts) uses `new AmbientLight( 0xAAAAAA, 1 )` and `new DirectionalLight( 0xffffff, 1 )` for **all** modes. The PMD and PMX examples share the same shader implementation; they load different models/material parameters/textures. A diagnosis should not assume that PMX format, the ambient light, or the new MMD shading equation is necessarily at fault.

## Expected outcome

1. **Gene Light PMX demo only:** Use **`AmbientLight( 0x888888, 1 )`** and **`DirectionalLight( 0x888888, 1 )`**, treating `0x888888` as a 24-bit RGB gray. Preserve the directional-light position `(-1, 2, 1)`, direction, intensity, camera and all other settings.
2. **All four Miku PMD Examples:** Preserve the current **`AmbientLight( 0xAAAAAA, 1 )`** and **`DirectionalLight( 0xffffff, 1 )`**, including Worker Physics. Preserve Issue #100's PMD change, not revert it.
3. **Investigate** why Gene Light appears overbright compared with the PMD demo, with actual evidence, not an unverified claim that changing a light color fixes the underlying rendering logic. Report the likely causes, remaining uncertainty and whether any genuinely incorrect PMX/MMD material behavior was found. A separate issue is appropriate for a confirmed renderer/loader bug; do not casually modify the library's MMD shading as part of a demo-only color trial.
4. The **maintainer will judge the visual result** after publication; no subjective outcome is claimed or used as a mandatory pre-merge condition.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement an explicit **mode === 'gene'** light-color selection in shared `examples/scene.ts`, with Gene ambient and directional colors both `0x888888` at intensity 1. All Miku modes (animation, Worker, audio, pose) retain ambient `0xAAAAAA` and directional `0xffffff` at intensity 1. No other scene/art-direction settings change.
- [ ] Add/update deterministic Examples assertions for color **and** intensity in each of the five modes, including Worker Physics and both rendering backends where applicable. Verify model startup and existing animation/physics behavior are not affected.
- [ ] Investigate the **actual shipped Gene_light.pmx's 13 material records**, comparing representative values (diffuse RGB/alpha, ambient RGB, specular RGB/power, toon modes/ramps, map references and affected morph defaults) with the PMD Miku example. Use the pinned real model bytes already used in the Examples inspection workflow; do not infer actual material values from counts alone or fabricate them. Include a concise, reproducible findings table or report.
- [ ] **Isolate and measure** the rendered Gene scene contributions at a fixed camera/pose: ambient **scene light** (Three's indirect diffuse), the PMX-authored **material ambient** (`0.5 * A` in `MMDToonMaterial`), directional diffuse, direct specular (especially the `shininess <= 0` constant-lobe behavior), and available sphere/toon or other effects. Compare controlled settings (e.g., light colors white / current / `0x888888`, lights separately off) and at least one representative PMD control. Use repeatable rendered pixel values / histograms or isolated numeric tests to identify which term produces over-range color and clipping, separating HDR/linear values from display color mapping.
- [ ] Check whether the changed direct diffuse normalization in #96/#97, additive scene ambient vs PMX material ambient, PMX-authored specular strengths, PMX vs PMD textures/toon controls, or renderer output conversion explain the observed difference. **Record verified causes and unknowns separately.** A test based solely on the project's own formula is not a native-MMD visual oracle.
- [ ] Keep MMD material/shader, PMD/PMX loader, physics, toon/shadow policy and color-management code unchanged for this *trial*. If investigation reveals a demonstrable library-level bug, document evidence and raise an independent issue with scope and test expectations; don't silently bundle an unproven shader rewrite.
- [ ] Update Examples README and lighting documentation, and refresh Gene's gallery thumbnail and capture metadata/provenance using the existing capture workflow where applicable. Keep the four Miku thumbnails/settings unchanged unless the capture verification workflow explicitly requires regeneration. No manual aesthetic sign-off is a pre-merge gate.
- [ ] Run typecheck, applicable unit/browser/Examples checks, built Examples validation and `git diff --check`; record what actually passed or was not runnable. Include the investigation report with code review or PR.

### Required post-merge verification

- **PENDING until performed:** Confirm latest Tests and Pages workflow results for the actual merge SHA, with run links, and verify the published Examples assets are associated with that SHA.
- **PENDING until performed:** Check public Gene PMX and Miku PMD Example startup, including Worker when applicable, and verify the deployed Gene lights are both `0x888888` while PMD colors remain unchanged.
- **Maintainer follow-up (not a pre-merge acceptance requirement):** Visually compare the updated Gene Light PMX Example and decide whether to keep `0x888888` or adjust it further. This decision is not evidence that the MMD shading implementation is correct.

## Context

- Existing setup [`examples/scene.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/scene.ts): both lights currently use the same colors in all modes.
- [`src/materials/MMDToonMaterial.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/materials/MMDToonMaterial.ts): directDiffuse uses unnormalized diffuse × light × toon, specular uses authored color × light × half-vector power; `finish()` separately adds authored PMX material ambient and indirect scene-light contributions.
- [`src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts): retains source diffuse, ambient, specular and shininess for both formats with source-to-linear conversion.
- [`scripts/inspect-gene-light.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/scripts/inspect-gene-light.ts) and [`examples/gene-light-inspection.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/gene-light-inspection.json) establish a reproducible, licensed Gene Light model inspection path. The existing summary reports **13 materials**, but does **not** record numeric shader parameters; extend local inspection for this diagnostic.
- Related [#96](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/96) (MMD-inspired direct lighting), [#98](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/98) (all light intensities 1), [#100](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/100) (all ambient lights `0xAAAAAA`). This Issue supersedes #100's color **for Gene PMX only**.
- Verified default branch when filed: `975a6dca846ff471a5a794c2bb6a17d51cae0b4a`.
